summary.text: Dani Isaacsohn is a Democratic state representative from Ohio who has represented District 24 since January 2023 and is running unopposed in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He was elected minority leader of the Ohio House on June 24, 2025.

paragraphs.text: Dani Isaacsohn earned a bachelor's degree from Georgetown University in 2011 and a J.D. from Yale Law School in 2013.

Ballotpedia lists his career experience as business owner and his affiliations as including Women of Cincy, the Jewish Community Relations Council, Public Allies, Bonds of Union, the Asylum Seeker Advocacy Project, Cincinnati Youth Collaborative, and MYCincinnati.
Isaacsohn assumed office in the Ohio House on January 1, 2023, succeeding Allison Russo.
He was elected minority leader on June 24, 2025, and Ballotpedia lists him as ranking member of the House Rules and Reference Committee.
